purpose: Management-prepared request register for SOC 2 Type I readiness and CPA fieldwork. The engaged auditor may add, remove, split, or renumber requests.

requests.title: Approved organization, scope, criteria, and as-of date
requests.timing: Before auditor engagement and freeze at the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Legal entity, address, organization chart, products, boundaries, criteria decision, as-of date, owner approvals, and signed auditor engagement.

requests.title: Approved system description and architecture
requests.timing: Final before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Management-approved system description, architecture, data flow, infrastructure, software, people, procedures, data, boundaries, subservice organizations, and complementary user controls.

requests.title: Policy approval and control-owner assignment
requests.timing: Approved without backdating before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Dated approval covering the complete policy set, named owners, effective date, review cadence, and communication evidence.

requests.title: Approved enterprise security risk assessment
requests.timing: Current at the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Approved risks, likelihood, impact, treatment, residual ratings, owners, acceptances, expiration dates, and change triggers.

requests.title: Complete workforce population and personnel controls
requests.timing: Complete population as of the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Employees and contractors, roles, start/end dates, confidentiality/IP terms, lawful screening decisions, training, onboarding, and offboarding evidence.

requests.title: Privileged-access population and management review
requests.timing: Source-system exports and approval as of the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: GitHub, Vercel, Convex, Resend, DNS/email, model-provider and audit-room accounts reconciled to workforce; roles, business need, MFA, shared/stale access removal, reviewer, and timestamp.

requests.title: Application authentication and tenant-authorization evidence
requests.timing: Deployed production version at the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Production configuration, source/deployed commit, fail-closed authentication, server-derived ownership, persistence enforcement, and passing isolation tests.

requests.title: Confidential-data storage and transmission safeguards
requests.timing: Deployed production version at the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Private storage, encrypted transport, owner-scoped paths, cache controls, upload limits, security headers, capability controls, and production configuration evidence.

requests.title: Retention, deletion, legal-hold, and backup-expiry evidence
requests.timing: Approved schedule and completed test before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Approved schedule, legal-hold procedure, end-to-end deletion test, signed receipt, all stores/caches/logs, exceptions, and vendor-confirmed backup expiration.

requests.title: Complete vendor population and due-diligence files
requests.timing: All enabled production vendors as of the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Legal entities, service, data, criticality, regions, contracts, DPA, assurance reports, retention/deletion, security, breach, recovery, annual review, and offboarding.

requests.title: Change-management and controlled-release evidence
requests.timing: Current settings plus one representative controlled release
requests.requiredContents: Repository protections, access, immutable automation, reviewed change, CI result, SBOM, release manifest, deployment approval, deployed commit, rollback route, and emergency-change procedure.

requests.title: Vulnerability management and independent penetration test
requests.timing: Final report and material-finding retest before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Scanning population, findings, severity, SLA, tickets, exceptions, metrics, authenticated penetration-test report, remediation, and retest letter.

requests.title: Central logging, alerting, and response test
requests.timing: Configured and successfully tested before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Source inventory, event classes, privacy exclusions, central destination, access, retention, alert rules, test event, delivery proof, acknowledgement, escalation, and corrective actions.

requests.title: Incident-response readiness and tabletop
requests.timing: Approved plan and completed exercise before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Named responders, counsel/forensics contacts, monitored intake, severity and notification rules, contact-tree test, tabletop attendance, injects, decisions, lessons, actions, retest, and approval.

requests.title: Continuity, backup, and recovery exercise
requests.timing: Approved objectives and completed exercise before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Dependencies, approved RTO/RPO, backup configuration, vendor commitments, restore of metadata/private object, hashes, tenant isolation, measured results, failover, actions, and retest.

requests.title: External-model and AI governance evidence
requests.timing: Every enabled production route as of the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Route approval, provider or customer gateway, contract/configuration, minimization and sanitization, retention/training settings, evaluation, human review, output limitations, and change approval.

requests.title: Quarterly management control review
requests.timing: Completed before the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Review of controls, access, risks, vendors, incidents, vulnerabilities, changes, exercises, evidence quality, exceptions, actions, owners, dates, and approval.

requests.title: Customer privacy, confidentiality, and legal terms
requests.timing: Counsel-approved versions effective at the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Privacy notice, DPA, service terms, confidentiality commitments, transfer mechanism, incident terms, subprocessors, retention/deletion, rights procedure, and counsel approval.

requests.title: Independent CPA engagement and request-list reconciliation
requests.timing: Before committing to the as-of date
requests.requiredContents: Executed engagement, CPA firm independence, scope/criteria/date confirmation, fees, deliverables, bridge/Type II plan, secure exchange, final auditor PBC list, and request-owner reconciliation.

requests.title: Management representations and final exception disposition
requests.timing: At examination completion
requests.requiredContents: Final exception register, subsequent events, known incidents and fraud representations, system-description assertion, completeness confirmation, signed representation letter, report review, and distribution approval.
